question: You have a $7,150/month salary and $12,000+ in Westpac Life Savings, but zero Australian credit file. Would you like to start an 'Initial Credit Footprint'?
why_asking: Why am I asking? You have 3 months of consistent salary credits from Canva and substantial savings, but no credit facilities (cards, loans, or postpaid contracts) reported to Equifax.
answer_options: Yes, recommend a low-limit Westpac card with auto-pay
I prefer to stay debit-only for now
Explain how a credit card builds an Australian score
impact: Core Impact: In Australia, you cannot build a credit score by simply saving money. Opening a modest $1,000–$2,000 credit card and paying it in full every month generates positive CCR data, establishing an above-average score within 6 months.

question: You paid a $250 upfront deposit to Origin Energy because you lacked local credit history, and you have paid every bill on time since. Want a record of that from your Westpac history?
why_asking: Why am I asking? On 3 Sep you paid a $250 security deposit to Origin Energy, and you have paid every monthly power bill on time since.
answer_options: Yes, add these on-time payments to my Westpac payment summary
Remind me in 90 days so I can ask Origin about my deposit
impact: Medium Impact: Your deposit is part of your agreement with Origin, so only you and Origin can change it. A clear on-time record from your Westpac history is something you can show them, or a future landlord or lender.

question: You paid $250 upfront for a 365-day Optus prepaid SIM. Want to set a little aside each month so big yearly payments like this are always covered?
why_asking: Why am I asking? On 22 Aug you made an upfront annual payment to Optus rather than taking out a standard monthly postpaid contract.
answer_options: Yes, start a Westpac savings goal of $21 a month for yearly bills
No, paying upfront works for me
impact: Low Impact: Your Optus plan is your choice and stays as it is. A small monthly saving means the next annual payment is already there when it is due.

question: You send $700/month overseas to family via Wise. Would you like to designate this as a fixed living allowance in your budget?
why_asking: Why am I asking? We detected regular $700.00 transfers to Wise on 6 Sep, 5 Oct, and 5 Nov.
answer_options: Yes, mark this as an ongoing family support commitment
No, these are discretionary transfers that can pause anytime
impact: Credit & Lending Context: When applying for future car loans or mortgages, banks scrutinize regular international transfers. Classifying them accurately prevents underwriters from treating flexible remittances as high-risk fixed debt obligations.

question: You have paid $2,800/month rent to Ray White on time for 6 consecutive cycles. Would you like to export a Verified Rent Certificate?
why_asking: Why am I asking? Your rental transfers of $1,400 cleared reliably every fortnight from 28 Aug through 5 Nov.
answer_options: Yes, generate a Westpac Verified Rental History PDF
impact: Alternative Credit Proof: While standard residential rent is not automatically reported to Equifax, generating an authenticated Westpac Tenancy Record bridges the trust gap with landlords and non-bank lenders before a formal score matures.
